title: 𠊎係客家人
created_from: User-provided transcription, timestamps, romanization, English, and Dutch

segments.english: Hey, Shuangxi (Double Happiness)!
Everyone, old friends, uncles, aunts...

segments.characters: 你心里明白我不必多讲
segments.romanization: Nǐ xīnlǐ míngbái wǒ bùbì duō jiǎng
segments.english: You know in your heart I don't need to say much
segments.dutch: Je weet in je hart dat ik niet veel hoef te zeggen

segments.characters: 我就是不用说你也能猜得到
segments.romanization: Wǒ jiùshì bùyòng shuō nǐ yě néng cāi de dào
segments.english: Even without me saying it, you can still guess it
segments.dutch: Zelfs zonder dat ik het zeg, kun je het wel raden

segments.characters: 世上的情意你体会不少
segments.romanization: Shìshàng de qíngyì nǐ tǐhuì bù shǎo
segments.english: You've experienced plenty of affection in this world
segments.dutch: Je hebt genoeg genegenheid in deze wereld ervaren

segments.english: Without me, where would you...

segments.characters: 吵死人！客家山歌把涯来听！
segments.romanization: Chháu-sî-ngìn! Hak-kâ sân-kô pâ ngài lòi thâng!
segments.english: So noisy! Sing a Hakka folk song for me to listen to!
segments.dutch: Wat een herrie! Zing een Hakka-volksliedje voor mij!

segments.romanization: Lòi chhiu lòi lò! Yit, ngi, sâm, si!
segments.english: Here we go! One, two, three, four!
segments.dutch: Daar gaan we dan! Een, twee, drie, vier!

segments.english: I am a Hakka person
I love eating Hakka food

segments.characters: 河源猪脚粉、同客家酿豆腐
segments.english: Heyuan pork trotter noodles and Hakka stuffed tofu
segments.dutch: Heyuan varkenspootnoedels en Hakka gevulde tofu

segments.english: Are my absolute favorites
I am a Hakka person
I love Hakka girls

segments.characters: 爱其够勤劳、爱其够善良
segments.romanization: Oi kì keu khiùn-lò, oi kì keu san-liòng
segments.english: Love that she is hardworking, love that she is kind-hearted
segments.dutch: Hou ervan dat ze hardwerkend is, hou ervan dat ze goedhartig is

segments.english: Love that she is generous
segments.dutch: Hou ervan dat ze gul en ruimhartig is

segments.english: Hey, girl (darling)!
Tomorrow morning I have to leave
Would you like to come over
To listen to me sing mountain/folk songs
segments.dutch: Om naar mijn volksliedjes te komen luisteren

segments.english: Hey, brothers!
I will only return next year
segments.dutch: Ik kom volgend jaar pas terug

segments.english: Would you like to come over
Come over and have a couple of drinks
